CPR_TRANSLATION.SourceHint: The line(s) as spoken in the original language.
CPR_TRANSLATION.EnglishHint: The matching English line(s). Line 1 pairs with line 1, line 2 with line 2, etc.
CPR_TRANSLATION.WarnEmpty: Enter at least one source/English line pair before transmitting.
CPR_TRANSLATION.WarnGmOnly: Only the GM can trigger the live translation effect.
CPR_TRANSLATION.SettingPositionHint: Where the translation subtitle bar appears on screen.
CPR_TRANSLATION.SettingFontSizeHint: Font size, in pixels, of the translation subtitle text.
CPR_TRANSLATION.SettingCharSpeedHint: Milliseconds per character while the line decrypts into English. Lower is faster.
CPR_TRANSLATION.SettingSourceHoldTimeHint: Milliseconds the original, untranslated source text is shown before the decrypt effect begins.
CPR_TRANSLATION.SettingHoldTimeHint: Milliseconds the fully-translated line stays on screen before it clears (or before the next line begins).
CPR_TRANSLATION.SettingGmOnlyHint: If enabled, only the GM can open the Live Translation dialog and trigger the effect.
